note: Canonicalization and capture vectors. numbers: serializer primitives only, IEEE-754 bit patterns and their ECMAScript Number-to-String form (rows marked RFC 8785 Appendix B are copied from the RFC); they prove serialization, not acceptance into the v2 commitment domain. domain: number tokens checked through raw parsing and through in-memory commitment, accepted with their canonical form or rejected (safe-integer rule of x-canonicalization). documents: raw JSON text (or raw_hex bytes) through the I-JSON parse boundary, with the exact canonical text and its sha256, or reject. alternates: wrong preimages whose sha256 must not match. tree_captures: a capture listing, the manifest it must yield and its sha256, or unbindable. tree_alternates: manifests a wrong walk yields; their digest fails launch_workspace_mismatch.
